attempts.label: DANDI:001249
attempts.paper_title: Post-ejaculatory inhibition of female sexual drive via heterogeneous neuronal ensembles in the medial preoptic area
attempts.entry_title: Post-ejaculatory inhibition of female sexual drive in the MPOA (Ishii et al. 2025)
attempts.description: Tests the findings of Ishii et al. (2025) on dandiset 001249, which holds the whole-brain light-sheet volumes of 14 TRAP2;Ai14 females behind Figure 2, and on the authors' Figshare deposit, which holds the data of every other figure (self-paced mating behavior, HCR in situ, calcium imaging of Vgat and Vglut2 MPOA neurons, chemogenetics). The Figure 2 claims are blocked, as the dandiset holds only raw volumes and computing the cell densities would need the 1.38 TB streamed, registered and segmented with a classifier that is not deposited.

notebooks.title: Reproducing Ishii et al. (2025) from dandiset 001249 and its Figshare deposit

outcomes.statement: The tdTomato+ cell densities computed from the dandiset's whole-brain images agree, brain by brain, with the densities in the paper's deposited table (tdTomato_summary.csv on Figshare) that its Figure 2 code reads.
outcomes.source: Data availability; Figure 2.ipynb at GitHub commit 4e98c43, cell 4
outcomes.quote: Whole brain FosTRAP activity mapping data is available on DANDI
outcomes.notes: The dandiset holds only the raw light-sheet volumes (TRAP and background channel per brain, uint16, uncompressed and unchunked), with no registration, segmentation, cell counts, atlas labels or region volumes. The data check read one middle plane of every brain and measured streaming at 67.4 MB/s in the executed notebook (35.5 to 65.2 MB/s in earlier runs; the rate varies), so reading the TRAP channels once (691 GB) takes 171 min and both channels (1382 GB, the background channel being the one registered to the atlas) 342 min, over the 60 min a notebook may run (docs/protocol.md, Author, step 3; CI fails a notebook over sixty minutes) and over the time left in the run. Cheaper reads were timed: full-width bands of rows stream at 20.4 MB/s and crops at 2.5 MB/s, and every 25th (or 10th) background plane of all 14 brains, enough for a registration, takes 7 (17) min; but every Figure 2 claim corrects over a family of atlas regions that covers the brain (Benjamini-Hochberg over the level-4 or level-6 regions, or the rank of the MPN among all regions), so each needs every region of every brain segmented at full resolution, and reading only the regions named does not test them. No registration (ClearMap), segmentation or density was computed. The segmentation would also need the ilastik classifier, which is not deposited and which the Methods trained on manually labelled chunks from four brains; this alone would block the claims as methods_underspecified, a second reason. The grouping part of the link holds: the 14 brains match the 14 rows of the subject table in the Figure 2 zip on Figshare (meta/metainfo.csv) by name (Sniff_n, Mount_n and Ejaculation_n against sub-Sniff-n and so on), and the dandiset's groups (4 Sniff, 5 Mount, 5 Ejaculation) equal the Stim labels of tdTomato_summary.csv (4 Appetitive, 5 Consummatory, 5 Post_ejaculatory). The density part, which decides the outcome, was not run, as there are no densities from the dandiset to compare with the table's.

outcomes.statement: In hormone-primed females, zone transitions decrease and time in the isolation zone increases after male ejaculation, compared with before ejaculation and with the control trial.
outcomes.source: Figure 1G and 1H; Results, Female sexual motivation is suppressed after male ejaculation, paragraph 2
outcomes.quote: we found that there was a significant decrease in the number of zone transitions as well as a significant increase in the time spent in the isolation zone after male ejaculation

statistics.about: time in isolation zone, three epochs
time in isolation zone, post against pre
time in isolation zone, control against post

outcomes.notes: Isolation zone entries per 10 min 6.40 (control), 5.33 (pre), 1.79 (post); RM ANOVA F(2,16) = 10.888, p = 0.00104; Tukey post against pre p = 0.0142, control against post p = 0.0015. Average isolation visit 47.1, 128.6 and 389.1 s; F(2,16) = 14.344, p = 0.00027; Tukey 0.0057 and 0.0004. All equal the legend. Visits to either zone per 10 min give the same pattern (F = 6.714, p = 0.0076; 0.0210 and 0.0114). The total time in the isolation zone per 10 min, not the legend's quantity, does not differ between pre and post (Tukey p = 0.777).
deviations: Transitions are the code's isolation zone entries per 10 min (Figure 1.ipynb); the legend's "transitions between the zones" read as visits to either zone, counted from merge_df, is shown as a variant, since the table's Number_of_Entry_per_10min is empty for the control trial.
Average time in the isolation zone is the mean visit duration per animal and epoch from merge_df, as Figure 1.ipynb computes it; the column Time_in_Isolation_zone_per_10min holds the same values.

outcomes.statement: Latency to return to the interaction zone is longest after male ejaculation, longer than after sniffing or mounting.
outcomes.source: Figure 1I; Results, Female sexual motivation is suppressed after male ejaculation, paragraph 2
outcomes.quote: This was the largest after the female experienced male ejaculation when compared to after sniffing or after mounting
outcomes.notes: Mean latency 438.3 s after ejaculation, 105.2 s after sniff, 159.5 s after mount; RM ANOVA F(2,16) = 11.870, p = 0.000691; Tukey ejaculation against sniff p = 0.0016 and against mount p = 0.0077, as in the legend. Four of nine ejaculation latencies and one mount latency are at the 600 s cap.

outcomes.statement: After ejaculation, female-to-male sniffing does not change, while mounting and intromission decrease and self-grooming increases (hormone-primed females).
outcomes.source: Figure 1J to 1M; Results, Female sexual motivation is suppressed after male ejaculation, paragraph 2
outcomes.quote: while there was no change in the amount of female-to-male sniffing, there was a significant decrease in the number of mounting and intromission episodes ... There was also a significant increase in the number of self-grooming behavioral episodes
outcomes.notes: Mounting and intromission fall to 0 in all 9 mice (Wilcoxon p = 0.0039 exact, the legend's value); grooming rises in 7 of 9 (3.50 to 13.54 per 10 min; p = 0.0234 exact, 0.0251 with the normal approximation that gives the legend's 0.025061844); sniffing does not change (p = 0.652 exact, 0.594 approximate). Pairing by row order, as the code does, gives the same p-values.
deviations: Pairs are matched by animal id, where the code pairs by row order; scipy 1.18 chooses exact or approximate p-values itself, so both are shown.

outcomes.statement: Naturally cycling estrus females show the same post-ejaculatory changes, with a strong reduction of sniffing and no change in self-grooming.
outcomes.source: Figure 1N to 1T; Results, Female sexual motivation is suppressed after male ejaculation, paragraph 2
outcomes.quote: Animals that were in their natural estrus cycle showed similar behavior changes after experiencing male ejaculation ... showed a strong reduction of sniffing after experiencing male ejaculation but no changes in self-grooming behaviors
outcomes.notes: Transitions F(2,10) = 7.542, p = 0.0101 (Tukey post against pre p = 0.0038); average isolation time F(2,10) = 15.714, p = 0.00082; latency F(2,10) = 38.364, p = 2.04e-05. Sniffing, mounting and intromission are lower after ejaculation in all 6 mice (p = 0.03125 exact, 0.0277 approximate); grooming p = 0.4375 exact and 0.3452 approximate (the legend's value), not significant.

outcomes.statement: Virgin females spend more time in the isolation zone than sexually experienced females; the number of isolation zone entries also differs between the two groups.
outcomes.source: Figure 1-figure supplement 1; Results, Female sexual motivation is suppressed after male ejaculation, paragraph 2
outcomes.quote: the virgin female mice stayed in the isolation zone significantly longer than sexually experienced females
outcomes.notes: Pre-ejaculation epoch, 6 virgin and 6 experienced females. Isolation zone entries 2.42 against 6.36 per 10 min, Mann-Whitney p = 0.0411, so virgin females make fewer entries. Average isolation visit 545.8 against 72.0 s from the visit table (p = 0.0411), and 582.4 against 72.0 s in the column Figure S1.ipynb tests (p = 0.0260, the legend's value).
deviations: The legend's "average time spent in the isolation zone" is computed from the visit table (merge_df_virgin_SE.csv); Figure S1.ipynb tests the column Time_in_Isolation_zone_per_10min, shown as the second reading. Both are significant with virgin females higher.

outcomes.statement: The post-ejaculatory reduction in sexual motivation does not depend on the state of the male; with a novel sexually active male after ejaculation, females still make fewer isolation zone entries and spend more time there.
outcomes.source: Figure 1-figure supplement 2; Results, Female sexual motivation is suppressed after male ejaculation, paragraph 2
outcomes.quote: When the female animal was introduced to a novel sexually motivated male animal immediately after they experienced male ejaculation from another mouse, they showed a similar reduction in zone transition and an increase in the time spent in the isolation zone
outcomes.notes: Isolation zone entries fall from 2.33 to 0.43 per 10 min (6 of 7 lower, none higher), Wilcoxon p = 0.0312 exact and 0.0273 approximate (the legend's 0.027281171). Average isolation visit 595.7 to 1627.8 s (6 of 7 higher), p = 0.0312 exact and 0.0277 approximate. The code's column, interaction zone entries, gives the same p-values.
deviations: The legend (panel B) names entries into the isolation zone; Figure S2.ipynb tests Interaction_zone_entry. The legend's column is the main reading and the code's a variant; they agree.

outcomes.statement: By HCR, the proportion of Fos+ cells is higher after ejaculation than in the appetitive group in the MPN but not in nearby regions (MPA, BNST, LPO, VLPO).
outcomes.source: Figure 3D; Results, Male ejaculation is represented by both inhibitory and excitatory cell types in the MPOA, paragraph 2
outcomes.quote: we found that the number of Fos + cells in the post-ejaculatory group was significantly higher than the appetitive group in the MPN but not in the nearby regions
outcomes.notes: Recomputed from the per-cell HCR table (365002 cells, 10 mice). MPN Fos+ share 0.170 against 0.090, t(8) = -4.2709, Bonferroni p = 0.0136; MPA t(8) = -1.8413, p = 0.514; BNST, LPO, VLPO p = 1. These equal the legend. The per-mouse means equal the deposited per-section table to 4e-10.

outcomes.statement: In the MPN, both Vglut2+ and Vgat+ cells expressing Fos increase after ejaculation, with a higher proportion of Fos+ cells in the Vgat population.
outcomes.source: Figure 3I; Results, Male ejaculation is represented by both inhibitory and excitatory cell types in the MPOA, paragraph 2
outcomes.quote: Vglut2 and Vgat cells expressing Fos were significantly higher in the post-ejaculatory group than in the appetitive group, suggesting that male ejaculation activates both excitatory and inhibitory neurons ... The proportion of Fos+ cells was higher in the Vgat population
outcomes.notes: Exclusive populations (the code's table). Vgat Fos+ share 0.132 to 0.235, t(8) = -3.5361, Bonferroni p = 0.0153; Vglut2 0.095 to 0.160, t(8) = -3.3885, p = 0.0190, the legend's values. After ejaculation Vgat 0.235 against Vglut2 0.160 (no test, as in the paper). With inclusive populations both are significant (0.0131, 0.0091) and Vgat stays higher (0.251 against 0.209).
deviations: The paper does not say whether a cell called both Vgat+ and Vglut2+ (5013 of 68807 MPN cells) belongs to either population. The table Figure S5.ipynb reads counts only cells with one of the two, which the per-cell data reproduce to 4e-10; this is followed, as the code settles what the Methods leave open (protocol, reader step 2), and the inclusive populations are shown. The outcome is the same under both.

outcomes.statement: Fos induction after ejaculation is found in Vglut2 cells only when they co-express Calcr, and in Vgat cells co-expressing Calcr, Gal or Prlr; among clusters, the Vglut2, Vgat and Gal types have more Fos+ cells after ejaculation, while the Nts type does not.
outcomes.source: Figure 3J to 3M; Results, Male ejaculation is represented by both inhibitory and excitatory cell types in the MPOA, paragraph 2
outcomes.quote: in the Vglut2 cells, we found that Fos induction was only observed in the cells that co-expressed Calcr ... Type 1 ... and type 3 ... had significantly more Fos+ cells from the post-ejaculatory group compared to the appetitive group ... In contrast, Fos+ cells were not induced in type 4
outcomes.notes: Vgat subsets with Calcr (Bonferroni p = 0.0318), Gal (0.0174) and Prlr (0.0212) and the Vglut2 Calcr subset (0.0146) rise after ejaculation; the other Vglut2 subsets do not (0.104 to 0.822), so the "only Calcr" part holds. Clusters Vglut2+ 0.0189, Vgat+ 0.0022, Gal+ 0.0265, Nts+ 0.377. All equal the legend. Inclusive populations give the same pattern (Vglut2 Calcr 0.0044, other Vglut2 subsets 0.0706 to 0.413). The Calcr+ cluster has 4 post-ejaculatory mice, as one has no cell in it.
deviations: Exclusive Vgat and Vglut2 populations as in fig3i-vgat-vglut2-fos, with the inclusive ones shown.
The cluster names come from the deposited Seurat table; the step that names the clusters is not in the paper's code, so the clustering was not run again.

outcomes.statement: Vgat cells show higher average response magnitude than Vglut2 cells after sniffing, self-grooming, male anogenital sniffing and ejaculation, but not after mounting or intromission.
outcomes.source: Figure 4H; Results, A subpopulation of MPOA Vgat cells responds to male ejaculation, paragraph 1
outcomes.quote: Vgat cells showed significantly higher average response magnitude after sniffing, self-grooming, anogenital sniffing, and male ejaculation than the Vglut2 cells
outcomes.notes: Vgat against Vglut2, Bonferroni over six; ejaculation 2.11 against 0.85, t(791) = 3.998, p = 0.00042; sniff t = 6.463, p = 1.08e-09; anogenital sniffing t = 6.644, p = 3.4e-10; mount t = 0.337 and intromission t = -0.320, p = 1. All equal the legend. Grooming t = -7.252, Vgat lower, against the Results sentence, as the claims file notes; it is left out of the outcome. With the rescaled 200-frame arrays the same three differ and mount does not (p = 0.106). The cells come from 6 Vgat and 4 Vglut2 mice; with animal means as units no behavior differs after Bonferroni correction (ejaculation 2.23 against 0.88, t = 1.483, p = 0.176; sniff p = 0.440; anogenital sniffing p = 0.141; grooming p = 0.019, corrected 0.114), so the outcome rests on cells as units, as in the paper and the criterion. For the five behaviors other than ejaculation the test checks the authors' deposited magnitudes, not a computation from traces.
deviations: The ejaculation magnitude is recomputed from the -5 to +120 s trace (it equals the table to 5e-9). For the other five behaviors the magnitudes come from the deposited table, because the traces the Methods compute them from are not deposited; the deposited 200-frame arrays are rescaled and do not give the table's magnitudes (r = 0.53 to 0.89).
The Methods' exclusion of sniffs after the first mount could not be checked, as it happens before the deposited table and the code that does it is not in the repository.

outcomes.statement: A larger proportion of Vgat than Vglut2 cells respond positively to ejaculation (184/522 against 35/271) and to sniffing (29/522 against 1/271).
outcomes.source: Figure 4I; Results, A subpopulation of MPOA Vgat cells responds to male ejaculation, paragraph 1
outcomes.quote: Vgat cells also contained a significantly higher proportion of cells that positively respond (>2δ) to sniff and male ejaculation onset
outcomes.notes: Ejaculation 184/522 Vgat against 35/271 Vglut2 (Bonferroni p = 1.5e-10), sniff 29/522 against 1/271 (p = 0.0017), the legend's counts and p-values. Every animal has ejaculation responders (5 to 55); 26 of the 29 Vgat sniff responders come from one animal (Vgat_4). With a threshold of 1.5 or 2.5 the Vgat proportion stays higher for both behaviors. With animals as units the ejaculation responder fraction is 0.373 (Vgat) against 0.146 (Vglut2), t-test p = 0.104 and Mann-Whitney p = 0.038, and the sniff fraction 0.050 against 0.007 (p = 0.46 and 0.694).

outcomes.statement: Among cells responding to sniff, mount or ejaculation, ejaculation-specific cells are the most numerous (177, against 46 mount and 12 sniff), and most ejaculation responders are specific (Vgat 80%, Vglut2 82%).
outcomes.source: Results, A subpopulation of MPOA Vgat cells responds to male ejaculation, paragraph 2; Figure 5A to 5D
outcomes.quote: the number of cells that specifically responded was largest to male ejaculation with 177 cells, next to mount with 46 cells, and to sniff with 12 cells
outcomes.notes: Both readings give 178 ejaculation-specific, 48 mount-specific and 12 sniff-specific cells (the legend's numbers; the Results' 177 and 46 are within tolerance), and the recomputed classes equal the table's for all 793 cells. Specific shares of ejaculation responders, Vgat 149/184 = 0.810 and Vglut2 29/35 = 0.829. Every animal has ejaculation-specific cells (2 to 44); the 12 sniff-specific cells come from Vgat_3 (3) and Vgat_4 (9).

outcomes.statement: Sniff-specific and ejaculation-specific cells respond more strongly than the other classes only to sniff and to ejaculation, respectively; mount-specific cells respond more strongly than the other classes to mount, intromission and anogenital sniffing, but not to sniff or ejaculation.
outcomes.source: Results, A subpopulation of MPOA Vgat cells responds to male ejaculation, paragraph 2; Figure 5C
outcomes.quote: sniff cells and completion cells only showed significantly stronger responses than the other cells to sniff and male ejaculation, respectively ... Mount responsive cells showed significantly stronger response than the other cells to mount, intromission and anogenital sniffing, but not to sniffing and male ejaculation

outcomes.notes: F(2,235) = 73.35 (sniff), 68.32 (mount), 15.72 (intromission), 12.34 (anogenital sniffing), 49.59 (ejaculation), the legend's values. Sniff cells exceed both other classes for sniff and ejaculation cells for ejaculation (Tukey p at most 0.0001); mount cells exceed both for mount and exceed ejaculation cells for intromission and anogenital sniffing (p < 0.0001); mount cells are below sniff cells for sniff (0.459 against 2.504) and below ejaculation cells for ejaculation (-0.517 against 5.902).

outcomes.statement: Ejaculation-responding Vgat cells have a longer decay length than Vglut2 cells.
outcomes.source: Figure 6C; Results, MPOA Vgat cells display prolonged activity, paragraph 1
outcomes.quote: Vgat cells had significantly longer decay length compared to the Vglut2 cells
outcomes.notes: Re-run on the reader's answer of 2026-11-01 (questions/001249.yaml), which added reading (c), the time from the peak after onset to the first sample below 0 after it, to the criterion; the first run of this attempt, on readings (a) and (b) only, gave not_reproduced. Under (c) Vgat responders take 45.2 s against 20.9 s in Vglut2, t = 3.037, p = 0.0027 (paper t(217) = 3.040, p = 0.00266), and (c) equals the deposited decay lengths for 207 of 219 cells (r = 1.000). The result rests on giving the 44 cells that never fall below 0 after the peak (43 Vgat, 1 Vglut2; 31 in mouse Vgat_2) the full 120 s, as the deposited table does for all 44. Counting them as the time from the peak to the end of the window gives 28.9 against 20.6 s (p = 0.111); leaving them out gives 22.4 against 18.0 s (p = 0.299). Under (c) the rank-sum test gives p = 0.187 and the animal means 40.9 against 20.2 s (6 and 4 mice, p = 0.149). Reading (a), onset to the first sample below 0, gives 18.7 against 22.2 s, t = -0.608, p = 0.544, and reading (b), total time below 0, 53.9 against 75.3 s, t = -2.641, p = 0.0089 (Vgat shorter). The authors are asked how the decay length is defined (finding). Reading (c) and the table differ for 12 of the 219 responders (11 in Vgat_4, 1 in Vglut2_3); none is a cell that never returns below 0, and the table is longer by 0.3 to 5.2 s in each. The outputs do not show which convention gives these 12 values.
deviations: Decay length computed from the deposited -5 to +120 s ejaculation traces under the claims file's three readings; the deposited precomputed values are shown as well.

Assumed, the paper not saying it, that a trace that never falls below 0 after the peak has a decay length of 120 s, the full window, because the deposited table (male_analysis_magnitude.csv, Ejaculation_decay_length_seconds) holds 120 for each of the 44 such cells. The outcome depends on it; the time to the end of the window and leaving the cells out are shown and give p = 0.111 and 0.299.

outcomes.statement: Spectral clustering of ejaculation responses gives five types; the late-response type 3 has the longest decay length and contains only Vgat cells, while Vglut2 cells are more often fast responders.
outcomes.source: Figure 6D to 6K; Results, MPOA Vgat cells display prolonged activity, paragraph 1
outcomes.quote: all the cells in type 3 were Vgat cells, suggesting that the increased activity in the MPOA late after the onset of male ejaculation is mediated by inhibitory neurons
outcomes.notes: 4 components by the code's elbow rule (it keeps the components before the elbow); the silhouette is largest at 5 clusters and 30 neighbours (0.474) for seeds 0 to 4, with labels equal to the deposited ones (adjusted Rand 1.0). The late cluster (mean peak at 48.5 s, longest decay under readings a and c) holds 37 of 184 Vgat and 0 of 35 Vglut2 cells, Bonferroni p = 0.0181; the fast cluster holds 16 of 35 Vglut2 against 26 of 184 Vgat cells, p = 6.8e-05, the legend's values. At the paper's stated 55 neighbours (silhouette 0.461, not 0.405) the late cluster holds 33 Vgat and 0 Vglut2 cells (p = 0.0328). The late cluster's 37 Vgat cells come from 5 of 6 Vgat mice, 27 from Vgat_2. The cluster whose mean trace peaks earliest (1.9 s, against 5.8 s for type 1) holds 41/184 Vgat and 5/35 Vglut2 cells (Bonferroni p = 1); it is the paper's Type 5, the negative response type (46 cells, 41 Vgat and 5 Vglut2, in the Figure 6 legend), not a candidate fast type, while type 1 has the legend's 42 cells (26 Vgat, 16 Vglut2) of the type the Results call fast response. At 55 neighbours the late cluster's 33 Vgat cells are outside the tolerance of 37 +/- 3.7.
deviations: The clustering selects 30 neighbours, as the paper's code printed, where the Methods state 55; both are shown.
The code fixes no seed; seed 0 is a standard choice and seeds 1 to 4 give the same labels.

The late cluster is identified as the one whose mean trace peaks latest. The fast cluster is type 1, the cluster with the largest mean 0 to 5 s response, because the code numbers the clusters that way (reorder_clusters in Figure 5 Spectral clustering.ipynb, which averages frames before_frames to 2 x before_frames) and the paper's type numbers are the code's; the cluster whose mean peaks earliest is shown as a variant. The paper's labels support the choice, as the Results call type 1 the fast response type and type 5 the negative response type, and the Figure 6 legend's counts (Type 1, 42 cells, 26 Vgat and 16 Vglut2; Type 5, 46 cells, 41 and 5) are those of type 1 and of the earliest-peak cluster.

The number of components follows the code's elbow rule, np.argmin of the rotated scree plot used as a count (transformed_data[:, :num_retained_pcs]), which keeps the components before the elbow; it gives 4, the code's printed value and the Methods' number.

outcomes.statement: CNO activation of post-ejaculatory TRAP-labeled MPOA neurons reduces zone transitions and increases time in the isolation zone; activation of appetitive or consummatory ensembles and eYFP controls do not.
outcomes.source: Figure 7F and 7G; Results, An activity-defined subset of neurons in the MPOA, paragraph 4
outcomes.quote: only post-ejaculatory-hM3Dq group showed significantly fewer number of transitions and spent more time in the isolation zone on the CNO trial than on the saline trial
outcomes.notes: By the main reading, the rank-sum test with Bonferroni over four groups, post-ejaculatory hM3Dq mice have fewer transitions on CNO (2.28 to 0.14 per 10 min, all 8 lower, p = 0.0076) and more isolation time (all 8 higher, p = 0.0025), and no other group changes isolation time (0.163 to 1). The consummatory hM3Dq group also has fewer transitions (2.13 to 0.31, 7 of 7 lower, p = 0.0157), so the "only" part fails for transitions. The code's paired signed-rank test (variant) gives the legend's values, post-ejaculatory 0.03125 for both measures and consummatory 0.0625 and 0.125, under which the claim would be reproduced. The rank-sum test ignores that the same mice are tested on saline and CNO. The round-1 verifier judged the rank-sum main reading a misreading of the paper; it is asked of a reader (questions/001249.yaml) and the claim is tested as the claims file has it.
deviations: Isolation time is run on both Duration_second, which the code tests, and Average_Isolation_zone_duration, the legend's quantity; the latter is in frames for three groups (ratio 15) and seconds for the consummatory group, which leaves the within-group tests unchanged. Both give the same p-values.

outcomes.statement: Activation of post-ejaculatory TRAP neurons lowers intromissions and receptivity in the self-paced assay; the text also reports fewer self-grooming and mounting episodes, which the legend gives as p = 0.0625.
outcomes.source: Figure 7H to 7L; Results, An activity-defined subset of neurons in the MPOA, paragraph 4
outcomes.quote: post-ejaculatory-hM3Dq group displayed fewer numbers of self-grooming, mounting, intromission and lower receptivity score on the CNO trial than on the saline trial
outcomes.notes: Post-ejaculatory hM3Dq, all 8 lower on CNO; intromission 5.5 to 0.25 (rank-sum Bonferroni p = 0.0026), receptive score 0.503 to 0.031 (p = 0.0033). Self-grooming 23.5 to 2.25 (p = 0.0103) and mounting 18.0 to 1.25 (p = 0.0093) by the rank-sum test; 0.0625 for both by the code's exact signed-rank test, the legend's value. The receptive score equals intromissions over mounts in all 39 rows with mounts (legend L). The choice of test is asked of a reader with fig7fg-activation-suppresses; the outcome is the same under both tests.

outcomes.statement: The number of TRAP-labeled cells does not differ between groups, but the proportion located in the MPN is higher in the post-ejaculatory group; most MPN TRAP cells are Vgat (0.76) and few Vglut2 (0.15).
outcomes.source: Figure 7-figure supplement 1B, 1C and 1G; Results, An activity-defined subset of neurons in the MPOA, paragraph 1

Vglut2: 0.15±0.13)

outcomes.statement: In the home cage, activation of post-ejaculatory TRAP neurons reduces sniffing and intromission compared with post-ejaculatory eYFP controls, without changing mounting; it does not induce place preference or aversion.
outcomes.source: Figure 7-figure supplement 2C to 2J; Results, An activity-defined subset of neurons in the MPOA, paragraphs 3 and 4
outcomes.quote: post-ejaculatory-hM3Dq group but not the appetitive-hM3Dq and consummatory-hM3Dq group showed significantly fewer sniffing events compared to post-ejaculatory-eYFP group ... there were significantly less intromission episodes
outcomes.notes: Against post-ejaculatory eYFP (6 mice), post-ejaculatory hM3Dq (8) sniff 4.4 against 27.3 (Bonferroni p = 0.0072) and intromission 1.4 against 32.2 (p = 0.0165); mounting p = 0.4116; appetitive and consummatory hM3Dq differ in nothing (smallest 0.258). The place-preference p-values against the eYFP group equal the legend's (time 0.2203 and 1, entries 1 and 1, velocity 1 and 0.8472); for post-ejaculatory hM3Dq against appetitive hM3Dq the legend prints 1, 1 and 0.8472 where the test gives 0.162, 0.696 and 0.0615, none significant either way.

outcomes.source: Figure 7-figure supplement 3; Results, An activity-defined subset of neurons in the MPOA, paragraph 5

outcomes.notes: Home cage on CNO, hM4Di (8) against eYFP (6), intromission 77.0 against 50.5 (p = 0.0045) and receptive score 0.836 against 0.653 (p = 0.0200); sniffing p = 0.697 and mounting p = 0.400, the legend's values. findings.statement: Each NWB file stores the z planes of a brain as the frames of an ImageSeries (acquisition/TRAP and acquisition/background) with starting_time rate 4.0, the z step in micrometres given as a sampling rate, resolution 3.6 and unit "lumen". No voxel size, orientation, channel wavelength or description is given; the descriptions are "no description".

The dandiset holds only the raw volumes of Figure 2. The registration to the atlas, the cell segmentation, the per-region counts and densities, and the trained ilastik classifier are not in it, so none of the Figure 2 results can be computed without rerunning the whole pipeline, and the classifier, trained on manual labels, cannot be rebuilt as it was. The per-region densities are only on Figshare (tdTomato_summary.csv), with no link to the volumes.

The volumes are stored uncompressed and unchunked, 1.38 TB for 14 brains. At the 35.5 to 67.4 MB/s measured in runs of this notebook, streaming the TRAP channels once takes 2.8 to 5.4 h and both channels 5.7 to 10.8 h, which puts any analysis of Figure 2 out of reach of a streamed notebook. A full-width band of rows can be read in one range request (20.4 MB/s in the executed notebook), a crop only row by row (2.5 MB/s).

The five consummatory (Mount) brains have session start dates of 2024-02-07, a year after the appetitive and post-ejaculatory brains (2022-12 to 2023-06), and their middle-plane TRAP intensities are lower (means 20 to 35 against 47 to 143). The dandiset does not say whether this is a separate imaging batch; it bears on the group comparisons of Figure 2.

In the Figure 1 tables on Figshare (group_df.csv, group_df_virgin_SE.csv) the column Time_in_Isolation_zone_per_10min holds the mean duration of an isolation zone visit in seconds (equal to the mean of merge_df to 4e-8), not a time per 10 min.

In the Figure 7 table (Figure 6 zip, group_df.csv) Average_Isolation_zone_duration is in frames (15 times Duration_second, up to 107887 in a 7200 s session) for three groups and in seconds for the consummatory hM3Dq group.

The calcium imaging arrays named *_all_norm_zscore_snip_array.npy are not the traces the Methods compute magnitudes from; for ejaculation each cell's trace is divided by its SD over -5 to 0 s, and their 0 to 5 s means do not give the deposited magnitudes (r = 0.53 to 0.89). Only the ejaculation trace from -5 to +120 s matches the Methods. The magnitudes of the other five behaviors can be taken only from the deposited table, and nothing describes the arrays.

The decay length of Figure 6C is defined in the Methods as "the time the z-scored signal was smaller than 0", and the code reads it precomputed. The deposited values equal the time from the peak after onset to the first sample below 0 for 207 of 219 cells, which gives the paper's result, while the time from onset to the first sample below 0, or the total time below 0, give Vgat no longer than Vglut2. The deposited table gives 120 s to each of the 44 responders whose trace never falls below 0 after the peak; with the time to the end of the window, or with these cells left out, Vgat is not longer at p < 0.05. The questions for the authors are whether the decay length is measured from the peak, what value a trace that never returns below 0 takes and why, and how the other 12 cells are computed.

The Methods state that the spectral clustering chose 55 nearest neighbours with an average silhouette of 0.405; the paper's code printed 30 neighbours and 0.474, the deposited labels are those of 30 neighbours, and no setting with 5 clusters scores 0.405 (0.461 at 55).
The Results give 177 ejaculation-specific and 46 mount-specific cells; the Figure 5 legend and the deposited data give 178 and 48.

The Figure 7 and Figure 7-figure supplement 3 legends name a Wilcoxon rank sum test for the saline against CNO trials; the code runs the paired signed-rank test, and the reported p-values (0.03125 for 8 mice) are those of the signed-rank test. With the rank-sum test the consummatory hM3Dq group also has fewer transitions (Bonferroni p = 0.0157).

Figure 7-figure supplement 1G reports t(10) = 6.6154 and t(12) = 13.9477; these are the t values of a paired test with the degrees of freedom of an unpaired one, and the reported p-values are the paired p doubled.

Figure 7-figure supplement 1B and C give 14 post-ejaculatory mice; the deposited table holds 15 (7 eYFP, 7 hM3Dq_Ejaculated, 1 hM3Dq_Post_ejaculatory), as F(2,24) requires. The legend of panel D says the appetitive-hM3Dq and post-ejaculatory-hM3Dq groups were used, while the post-ejaculatory group of panel G holds 4 eYFP and 3 hM3Dq mice.

In the HCR analysis of Figure 3, the Vgat and Vglut2 populations count only cells with one of the two calls; 5013 of 68807 MPN cells with both are left out. The paper does not say so; the per-cell table shows it.
Figure 1-figure supplement 2B is the number of entries in the isolation zone per the legend; Figure S2.ipynb tests Interaction_zone_entry. The two give the same p-value.

The NWB files do not give each brain's orientation in the stack. The Figure 2 subject table on Figshare (meta/metainfo.csv) does (Anterior_top, Ventral_first; the two differ between brains), and links each brain to the mouse ID and group of the density table through experiment_id, which matches the dandiset's subject names.

In the Figure 7-figure supplement 2H to 2J legend, the place-preference p-values for post-ejaculatory-hM3Dq against appetitive-hM3Dq (1, 1 and 0.8472) are not those the Mann-Whitney test with Bonferroni over three comparisons gives on the deposited table (0.162, 0.696 and 0.0615), which are the values Figure S10.ipynb prints; the comparisons with eYFP match. None is significant either way.

entries.name: 001249-ishii-2025
entries.title: Post-ejaculatory inhibition of female sexual drive in the MPOA (Ishii et al. 2025)
entries.description: Tests the findings of Ishii et al. (2025) on dandiset 001249, which holds the whole-brain light-sheet volumes of 14 TRAP2;Ai14 females behind Figure 2, and on the authors' Figshare deposit, which holds the data of every other figure (self-paced mating behavior, HCR in situ, calcium imaging of Vgat and Vglut2 MPOA neurons, chemogenetics). The Figure 2 claims are blocked, as the dandiset holds only raw volumes and computing the cell densities would need the 1.38 TB streamed, registered and segmented with a classifier that is not deposited.

notebooks.title: Reproducing Ishii et al. (2025) from dandiset 001249 and its Figshare deposit
